children: Sweden biotechnology firm's Q3 net sales rose 19% yr/yr
Q3 operating and net profit increased yr/yr
Growth driven by higher Selektope adoption and supportive shipping market conditions
Company expects further progress in business development initiatives during autumn
Company developing new biologically derived antifouling technology for aquaculture applications
Company awaits EU decision on medetomidine approval, prepared to challenge negative outcome
SELEKTOPE ADOPTION - Co said increased adoption of Selektope-based antifouling solutions drove sales and profit growth
SUPPORTIVE SHIPPING MARKET - Co said favorable shipping market conditions contributed to Q3 growth
CURRENCY IMPACT - Weaker SEK against USD provided slight tailwind to reported revenues
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for I-Tech AB is SEK87.00, about 20.2% above its October 15 closing price of SEK72.40
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 15 three months ago
